# Product Matching Relationship

## Scene classification and demand intensity

### Classification by operational value

| scene | Typical problem. | Main roles | Main value | Demand characteristics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AI Summary of meetings | Time-consuming records, unclear conclusions, lost tasks | Administration, project manager, HF participants | Savings in time and savings | It's easier to experience, with more alternatives of the same kind. |
| Sales growth | Clients scattered, follow-up untransparent, unpredictable. | Sales Director, Manager | Customer asset deposition, conversion and forecasting | Closely related to CRM usage and data quality |
| Procurement management | The price is low, the suppliers are difficult to evaluate, the budget is out of control. | Procurement, finance, managers | Reductions, synergies and compliance | Suitable for multi-supplier and high-frequency procurement organizations |
| Stock and sale | Inconsistencies, missing items, slow maintenance response | Storage, after sale, operation | Working capital, delivery and client services | Related to worksheets, material and inventory connection |
| Cross-sectoral approval | Slow processes, duplication of data, lack of accountability | Financial, administrative, management | Efficiency and internal control | Value depends on cross-sectoral flow |
| Personnel and finance automation | Recruitment, attendance, remuneration, manual processing of vouchers | HR, Finance | Saving people and reducing errors | Higher standardization and maturity of the same product |
| Operating the cockpit. | Different data calibres, delays in reporting | Corporate managers, managers of operations | Decision-making speed and business visualization | Dependence on master data quality and system integration |
| Conference on Privatization Security | Sensitive content is not suitable for the use of generic public clouds. | IT, legal, organizational manager | Risk control and compliance | Focus on deployment, security and auditing |
| Visualizing configuration application setup | Demand, IT, long schedule, traditional costs High | IT, Operations | Agility and reduced development costs | Need for authority, version and application governance |
| Multilingual/cross-regional collaboration | Languages, time zones, weak webs, inconsistent documents | Cross-border operations, regional directors | Delivery and collaboration | Conference and business systems portfolio needs are evident |

### By acquisition maturity

#### Level one: Sensory-type scenario - "Establishing the immediate sense of time"

|  |
| --- |
| AI proceedings; |
| OCR/AI automatic entry; |
| Natural language queries and reports; |
| Voice approval. |
| The advantage is that the test threshold is low and easy to produce a demonstration effect; the disadvantage is that the function is easily replicated by the head platform and the willingness to pay alone is limited. |

#### Second floor: sector scenario - "One responsible person can calculate ROI"

|  |
| --- |
| AI CRM； |
| Procurement and vendor management; |
| (d) Development/WMS; |
| HR/Finance process automation. |
| Such scenarios are best suited to the first list, as the responsible, budget, indicators and pilot borders are clearer. |

#### Third floor: business scenario — “More cross-sectoral data integration”

|  |
| --- |
| Harmonization of data base; |
| Processes from trail to payback, from procurement to payment, from the end to end of the worksheet to inventory; |
| Operating cockpit and cross-system AI questions; |
| Privatization AI smart body. |
| This is Kuailu's most differentiated and difficult to deliver value layer. Main data governance, system integration, organizational change and long-term services are needed and cannot be negotiated on standard demonstrations alone. |

### Classification by industry adaptation characteristics

| Industry | Demand Matches | Reason | Relevant scenes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured/equipment/fouling | High | Multi-SKU, multi-silo, procurement, production, after-sale and off-standard processes | Procurement - stock - after sale; CRM - refunds |
| Renewable resources/energy | High | Price fluctuations, cost accounting, retroactive and compliance | Procurement, costs, traceability, operating boards |
| Cross-border trade/textile | High | Cross-regional, order, procurement, production and delivery synergies | Orders - procurement - production - delivery; multilingual meetings |
| Medical equipment | High | Overriding, after-sale, equipment maintenance and compliance | CRM, WMS, EMS, VP. |
| Finance/China | Medium High | High value of security, auditing and privatization | Privatization conferences, contracts, knowledge questions and answers |
| Retail/American trade chain | Medium | There are many vendors, members and stockpiles in demand, but there are many mature competitions. | Store, purchase, board. |
| A simple Internet team. | Low | More generic collaboration and documentation and more mature collaboration platforms | Common collaboration and knowledge management |
